scope: Uniform q0 field only; original full 4^3 matter grid does not create finite-q photons. Finite BvK volume is neither external sample/cavity nor irreversible bath. No propagated noise, trajectories, material rates, equilibrium or full E/D completion. No new DFT, scientific runs or tests by worker.
scalar: E_total=N*[sum_s w_s Tr(rho_s (H0_A25_s+DeltaV0_s))+dv/2 delta_n.K.delta_n+u.(sum_s w_s Tr(rho_s (g_A25_s+Delta_g_s))+Gheld-FII-Fsupport)+u.(C_common+Delta_C_prepared).u/2+a.sum_s w_s Tr(rho_s L_physical_s)+a.C_field_prepared.a/2+u.T_prepared.a+sum_atom (P-Z*a)^2/(2 M_Ry)]+Pi^2/(2 M_Maxwell). rho_s=Psi_s D_s Psi_s^dagger with fixed original complex D; w_s=1/N for each independent full-grid spin/mesh sector; N=64. No extra spin factor. Base electronic held sector must be empty or its optical/zero-field coefficients supplied separately; this implementation requires empty held sector.

maxwell.momentum: Pi=M_a da/dtau, canonical conjugate of a
maxwell.scope: uniform periodic q0 Maxwell coordinate; zero magnetic stiffness

coefficients.spatial_correction: same onsite DeltaC added at R=0, equivalently at every existing matter q; no ASR repair

initial_join.energy_scope: mean scalar values below; product covariance correction reported separately
initial_join.absolute_energy_missing: actual full-slot H0/K evaluation; original-source representative energy is not transported H0
initial_join.scalar_join: E_total=64*(existing full-slot PreparedReference scalar+unanchored correction)+Maxwell; runtime JointPreparedFieldDynamics evaluates absolute scalar and every RHS together

product_cross_covariance: initially zero by explicit tensor-product hypothesis, not coupled equilibrium

field_preparation.hypothesis: centered sudden-release electronic/ionic/field tensor product; initial linear drift retained
